decisions.note: Locator 47:200282 is verified as JP 対抗意識○. Vietnamese has several plausible compact renderings (e.g. competitive spirit/rivalry awareness); defer until the whole passive-skill family can be named consistently rather than freezing one nuance.
Locator 47:200281 is verified as JP 対抗意識◎ and is the stronger tier of 対抗意識○. Defer together with the ○ form so both tiers receive one reviewed Vietnamese stem and preserve the ◎ marker consistently.

Locator 47:1200051 is verified as JP ダートレースへの想い. The repository fixes Dirt terminology, but 想い in this event-only title can naturally be rendered several ways; defer rather than calquing the Chinese 向往.

Locator 47:1200041 is verified as JP 短距離レースへの想い. Preserve the established concept Cự ly ngắn when eventually translated, but defer the title until the shared レースへの想い family receives one consistent Vietnamese construction.

Locator 47:200731 is verified as JP 勝利への執念. 執念 carries stronger persistence/obsession than ordinary determination, and multiple Vietnamese titles preserve that nuance differently; defer instead of locking a flattened wording.

Locator 47:1200031 is verified as JP マイルレースへの想い. The distance label must remain Mile, but the 想い construction should be reviewed consistently with the Dirt/Short/Long event-skill family before locking.

Locator 47:200821 is verified as JP 追込駆け引き. 追込 must map to Oikomi, while 駆け引き can mean tactical maneuvering/mind games; defer until a stable Vietnamese stem is chosen for all four running-style 駆け引き skills.
Locator 47:1200021 is verified as JP 長距離レースへの想い. Preserve the established Cự ly dài concept, but defer the title so the full レースへの想い family can share one natural Vietnamese naming pattern.

Locator 47:200791 is verified as JP 逃げ駆け引き. 逃げ must map to Nige; the Vietnamese rendering of 駆け引き is not yet canonical, so defer alongside 追込駆け引き rather than inventing inconsistent style-specific names.

Locator 47:101351 is verified as JP 黄金を訪ねて, Stay Gold's character-flavor unique skill. Several natural Vietnamese literary titles are possible; defer rather than treating the Chinese 寻访 as authoritative wording.

Locator 47:202711 is independently verified as JP 王手 (ōte), the standard shogi term for putting the king in check. 'Chiếu tướng' is the established Vietnamese game term; this avoids the incorrect literal reading of Chinese 将军 as a military general.

Locator 47:200122 is verified as JP 小倉レース場○. The target matches the canonical Kyoto/Hakodate racecourse-skill naming pattern and preserves the ○ tier marker.
Locator 47:200121 is verified as JP 小倉レース場◎. The target matches the canonical Kyoto/Hakodate racecourse-skill naming pattern and preserves the ◎ tier marker.

Locator 47:201422 is verified as JP 小休憩, a Sashi recovery skill. 'Short break', 'brief rest' and more conversational Vietnamese titles are all defensible; defer until skill-title style selects one concise canonical form.

Locator 47:202243 is verified as JP 小回り×. Its condition refers to compact/tight-turn racecourse layouts rather than merely a single 'small corner'; defer until 小回り has a precise series-wide Vietnamese term and preserve × when resolved.
Locator 47:202242 is verified as JP 小回り○. Defer together with 小回り× so the course-layout concept receives one accurate Vietnamese stem across ×/○/◎ instead of copying the Chinese 小弯道 literally.
